Name: Herod the Great
Summary: Herod the Great was the client king ruling Judea when Jesus was born. Hearing from the wise men of a newborn King of the Jews, he ordered the killing of the male children in Bethlehem, and Joseph fled with Mary and Jesus into Egypt.
KeyStory: Herod's soldiers searched Bethlehem for a baby king, while the child escaped to Egypt until Herod was dead.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Mary, Mother of Jesus; Joseph, Husband of Mary
LifeLesson: Earthly power panics at the true King. Herod's rage could not touch the child God was keeping.
